notes.title: Kingmakers at the Future Games Show!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Zm5I0BUL7LU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Kingmakers featured at the Future Games Show! [/h3]
Developer Ian Fisch took the stage to share a look into the game, diving into the lore related to the history of Owain Glyndŵr’s Welsh rebellion, unscripted destructible structures, thousands of soldiers, pathfinding fidelity, command armies, build, and the drop-in/drop-out co-op multiplayer campaign experience in our medieval simulation with modern weaponry.

We know you're eager for more news, especially about the release date now that we’re at the end of Q1. Trust us that the team is hard at work making Kingmakers the best it can be, and we host regular playtests to receive constant feedback. So, while we're not quite ready to release it just yet, we would be eternally grateful to have a little bit more of your patience and know that we are aiming to [b]release it in Q2 of this year.[/b]

[h3]In the meantime, we want to hear from you! [/h3]
We’re conducting a [b]community survey[/b] to get to know our players better as we prepare for launch. 
[b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSct7UQBNNfrDu8T4Tgw-K0NbRzI567kKWqossgmByFdfjfWRw/viewform]CLICK HERE to complete the survey![/url][/b]

Thank you so much for all your patience and support; stay tuned, and we’ll see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Winter Games Expo Kingmakers Trailer & Early Access Release in Q1 2025
notes.content:
[h3]Kingmakers hath made an appearance at the OTK Winter Games Expo, unveiling a fresh trailer and a newfound season for release![/h3]

[previewyoutube=ZXujvsd9C58;full][/previewyoutube]

Kingdom of England – Dec. 4, 1524 – People! I, the messenger o' His Grace, hereby declare that, per the decision o' publisher tinyBuild and developer Redemption Road Games, Kingmakers, known among the realm as an epic medieval sandbox mix o' third-person shooter, city builder and real-time strategy, shall grace the plains o' Steam withal its presence nay later than the [b]end o' Q1 2025[/b].  

The game hath amassed more than one million wishlists, and so His Grace is expecting a glorious battle, once the legendary warrior o' the future arriveth withal his allieth and an enormous arsenal o' peculiar weaponry ne'er ere seen across the entirety o' our Kingdom.  We have e'en received a pigeon withal a note mentioning ‘attack helicopters’ and ‘badass convertible sports cars’!

notes.title: Kingmakers is coming to the big screen!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889766/df5fc26605d9e52066d7695ad4b79a55364e6186.gif[/img]

We are absolutely thrilled to announce that Kingmakers is making it's way to the big screen!

[b]We have partnered with Story Kitchen to bring you a live-action film adaptation[/b] of our upcoming medieval time-traveling action game that allows players to bring an arsenal of assault rifles, humvees, and attack helicopters to war-torn medieval England, where they’ll assist Owain Glyndower’s 1401 Welsh Rebellion, via massive simulated battles. Story Kitchen’s adaptation will ask the question: What if Braveheart included time travel?. 

We at tinyBuild and Redemption Road Games, will be working with Story Kitchen to develop the film, aiming to tell a unique story and establish the IP. 

[h3][b][url=https://venturebeat.com/games/story-kitchen-will-take-tinybuilds-time-travel-game-kingmakers-to-live-action-film/]Read the full article here![/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Wreak Havoc Trailer - Destructible Structures in Kingmaker
notes.content:
[h3]Guess what? You’ve got a tank now. 🪖[/h3]

[previewyoutube=UrQd-y1wVo0;full][/previewyoutube]
The Wreak Havoc trailer premiered today at the tinyBuild Connect!

Picture yourself piloting a tank through a medieval village where every structure is vulnerable to destruction. Whether it's a cottage, a tavern, or a castle, you can storm inside, fight your way through, or blast it to rubble. And yes, it's all real-time, with dynamic physics in every collapse and explosion! Are you prepared to demolish your enemies’ fortifications using new anachronistic vehicles?

notes.title: Introducing Kingmakers
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=OvezgDni8z4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Welcome soldier,[/h3]

We are thrilled to introduce you to Kingmakers, a solo or co-op action/strategy sandbox game with real-time simulated battles in a war-torn medieval era and a modern hero.  Prepare yourselves to build, lead, fight, and change the course of history!

We are Redemption Road Games, a passionate 20-person dev team that has dedicated over four years to crafting this immersive experience. Our focus has been on pioneering technology, pushing the boundaries of Unreal Engine to deliver an unparalleled gaming experience. From rendering and animations to sophisticated AI and cutting-edge online multiplayer code, we're confident that Kingmakers will stand out in the Unreal Engine landscape.

Drawing inspiration from beloved titles like the Mount and Blade series, Deeprock Galactic, Kingdom Come Deliverance, Chivalry, Stronghold series, World War Z, and so many more, we've curated a unique blend of inspirations to give you an epic experience.

We're planning to launch Kingmakers in Early Access on Steam later this year, and we'd like to invite you to join us on this incredible journey from the very beginning. When we open our gates to the community with Playtests, Demos and Early Access, we seek your invaluable input to shape the future of the game. Be part of the development process, and share your desires for what you wish to see in Kingmakers.

Your enthusiasm and support mean the world to us! Add Kingmakers to your Steam Wishlist, and connect with us on Discord or through our community channels linked below. Together, let's make history and forge an unforgettable legacy!
